# Matt E. Jones

> Personal website and technical blog of Matt E. Jones — a customer-facing technical specialist and generalist engineer with a background in enterprise support, business systems (Salesforce, Zendesk, HubSpot), Java microservices, and applied AI/LLM tooling. Site includes a CV, engineering write-ups, and side projects.

## Blog

- [Setting up my blog](https://mej.xyz/blog/001-setting-up-blog): Some notes on setting up my blog
- [Astro wouldn't start](https://mej.xyz/blog/002-npm-errors-with-versions): When running Astro on Linux, I couldn't get it to start. Here is how I fixed that
- [Decompiling java on the fly in vim](https://mej.xyz/blog/004-vim-java-class-decompilers): Using Vim with Java Decompilers for fun code browsing
- [Kubernetes install guides need updating](https://mej.xyz/blog/005-kubernetes-install-instructions-bork): When unmaintained recipes need updates due to deprecation
- [Some notes on how my website works](https://mej.xyz/blog/006-how-my-website-works): Documenting current and future website setup
- [When OpenBSD's virtio Driver Says "No Carrier"](https://mej.xyz/blog/013-proxmox-openbsd-vio/proxmox-openbsd-networking): Debugging why OpenBSD VMs on Proxmox show permanent "no carrier" on VLAN-tagged virtio interfaces, and what I learned about interrupt handling along the way
- [Website infrastructure improvements](https://mej.xyz/blog/014-how-website-now-works): Migrated to Cloudflare Pages for an easier life
- [Structured output and the thinking budget trade-off](https://mej.xyz/blog/015-structured-output-thinking-budget): Why you can't always have structured output and extended thinking at the same time, and what to do about it
- [Exploring an LLM Judge and human-in-the-loop patterns](https://mej.xyz/blog/016-llm-judges-and-reasoning): Building better quality text output with no-cost judges
- [Lightweight data analysis on a shoestring](https://mej.xyz/blog/017-lightweight-practices-for-data-analysis): How to build a reproducible data analysis pipeline from scratch, using only local tools and version control such as SQLite, DuckDB, Python and Git
- [Windows Window Manager](https://mej.xyz/blog/020-windows-windows-manager): Notes on getting started with komorebi, a tiling window manager
- [Spotify Play History](https://mej.xyz/blog/021-spotify-play-history): Overcoming the 50 song limit on Spotify play history
- [Building a custom MCP for my Homelab](https://mej.xyz/blog/023-homelab-mcp-solution): Exploring ideas around automated system controls with AI

## Projects

- [BD-locator](https://mej.xyz/projects/bd-locator): Identify local partnerships in the care sector
- [The Chopper Project](https://mej.xyz/projects/chopper): Building a leaf fragmentation simulator, running 40,320 parameter combinations across a home compute grid, and using symbolic regression to derive a formula for how many passes it takes to chop N leaves to a target size
- [Company Lens](https://mej.xyz/projects/company-lens): Enrich UK Companies House data with LLM-inferred and verification-backed domain intelligence
- [Spotify Play History](https://mej.xyz/projects/spotify-play-history): Spotify play history poller for collecting long term music preferences
